content:
利用泰勒展开：
\[
\frac1{n+\sqrt{k}}=\frac1n\cdot \frac1{1+\sqrt{k}/n}
=\frac1n-\frac{\sqrt{k}}{n^2}+O\left(\frac{k}{n^3}\right)
\]
因此
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1{n+\sqrt{k}}
=1-\frac1{n^2}\sum_{k=1}^n \sqrt{k}+O\left(\frac1n\right)
\]
又
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \sqrt{k}=\frac23 n^{3/2}+O(n)
\]
所以
\[
1-\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1{n+\sqrt{k}}
=\frac{2}{3\sqrt n}+O\left(\frac1n\right)
\]
于是
\[
L=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sqrt n\left(1-\sum_{k=1}^n\frac1{n+\sqrt k}\right)
=\frac23
\]

答案：B
